subject: general
question: Which of the following is a comprehensive and in-depth analysis of a country's financial sector, done jointly by the World Bank and IMF in developing and emerging market countries?

options.text: Finance and Socio Economic Audit Scheme
Evaluation and Monitoring of the Financial Sector

solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Financial Sector Assessment Program.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Financial Sector Assessment Program (FSAP) is a comprehensive and in-depth analysis of a country's financial sector.
 
• **The goal of FSAP assessments is twofold**:
 
 
• to gauge the financial sector's stability and soundness and
 
• assess its potential contribution to growth and development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• International Monetary Fund (IMF) :

 
 
• The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is an organization of 189 member countries, each of which has representation on the IMF's executive board in proportion to its financial importance.
 
• The IMF, also known as the Fund, was conceived at a UN conference in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, United States, in July 1944.
 
 
 
• The World Bank :
 
 
• The World Bank Group is a unique global partnership:
 
 
• five institutions working for sustainable solutions that reduce poverty and build shared prosperity in developing countries.
